purpose: Create a reproducible, policy-grounded learning benchmark without using patient records or arbitrary labels.
source_of_features: Frozen Medical Metaverse state variables and institution-specific observation scopes.
source_of_labels: Deterministic institutional oracle derived from frozen policy, mandate, safety and evidence rules established before learning.
agent_partitioning: Each institutional agent receives only mandate-relevant observations; no omniscient feature table is used for B5.
perturbation_rationale: Controlled perturbations provide multiple realizations of the same institutional decision boundary so the learner is tested on mappings rather than scenario wording.
split_rationale: Agent-aware grouped train/dev/test splitting prevents variants from the same perturbation group leaking across partitions.
ood_rationale: OOD cases combine known policy variables in combinations absent from atomic training templates to test compositional generalization and rule precedence.
safety_rationale: Learned competence is evaluated separately from execution safety; a deterministic policy shield retains final authority over PERMIT/BLOCK/ESCALATE.
